request: Independent Assurance & Acceptance is asked to evaluate PO-03 Wave A. PO-03 does not self-certify and makes no acceptance claim of its own.
self_assessed_basis: Of 64 counted units, 32 carry a terminal independent disposition and 32 remain NOT_TESTED. Thirteen of the 32 reviewed units stand REJECTED. The commission requires every counted unit to carry a terminal durable disposition before PO-03 is an acceptance candidate, so that condition is not met.

acceptance_candidate_controls.every_counted_unit_disposition_detail: 32 of 64 disposed; immutable locators complete for all 64 in workstreams/po03/evidence/wave-a-result-locators.json
acceptance_candidate_controls.transactional_recovery_detail: 45 injected fault classes with 36 PASS, 8 FAIL and 1 observation-only; every FAIL was converted into a repaired defect with a regression test, and zero false completions were observed across all injections
acceptance_candidate_controls.os_metrics_detail: 64 rows by 27 fields; 532 cells NOT_SUPPORTED, each with an observed boundary rather than a substituted default
acceptance_candidate_controls.g0_g1_g2_detail: G0 7/26, G1 20/26, G2 26/26, measured lift 0.2308 against a preregistered 0.05 threshold; the instrument is saturated at G2, the G2 false-green rate is an empty-denominator convention, one producer authored suite holdout and successor, and the measured G1 is the 5ef49cb snapshot rather than current code
acceptance_candidate_controls.fresh_checkout_detail: the integration branch reproduces the 110-test controller suite from a clean clone; the 64 units' own tests live on eight cohort branches because merging is forbidden, and all are locatable by immutable object id

material_findings_against_po03_itself.summary: Twelve correctness defects were found in the controller's own custody mechanism by four cohorts using unrelated methods, and repaired with regression tests. The controller's own 84-test suite had caught none of them.
material_findings_against_po03_itself.highest_severity: an allowlist bypass in the changed-path guard, which admitted any .yml at arbitrary depth beneath a .github/workflows/po03-* directory

known_defects_not_repaired.subject: forged append to the hash-chained event log
known_defects_not_repaired.observed_boundary: no signing key or attestation service is exposed to this runtime; a hash chain constrains order and content, not authorship, and an appender able to forge can also re-anchor
known_defects_not_repaired.position: the log is tamper-evident against alteration and truncation and is not authenticated against a writer holding repository access; a keyless scheme described as authenticated was refused

known_defects_not_repaired.subject: absolute worktree paths embedded in three committed bytecode blobs on po03/wa-b2e7-c7
known_defects_not_repaired.position: the emitter defect that counted bytecode is repaired and the affected manifests are recorded RETEST, but the leaked bytes are deliberately not rewritten, because rewriting durable evidence to conceal a defect is the failure mode this programme exists to prevent

known_defects_not_repaired.subject: 10 of 42 early manifests counted interpreter bytecode as durable artifacts
known_defects_not_repaired.position: already-ingested results were not regenerated, since silently reissuing them would defeat the custody guarantee; the exact scope is recorded

retractions_by_this_controller.claim: unit 055's concurrency measurement is evidence against widening dispatch for Wave B
retractions_by_this_controller.reason: the result restates the experiment's own assumed formulas and is not evidence about real systems
retractions_by_this_controller.lesson: a coordinator relaying a producer headline number before auditing its construction reproduces the false green it exists to catch

retractions_by_this_controller.claim: cohort internal concurrency of 3 with a theoretical peak of 32 in flight
retractions_by_this_controller.reason: no subagent dispatch tool is exposed to a subordinate run, so nested delegation is unavailable and the real peak is 9 at the parent layer
retractions_by_this_controller.retained: the superseded block is kept as evidence rather than deleted

independent_review_evidence.cross_family_independence: every reviewed unit was produced by a family neither reviewer belongs to
independent_review_evidence.blind_protocol: frozen acceptance hash recorded before disclosure, component independently executed in scratch, original hidden cases authored, producer conclusion read only afterwards
independent_review_evidence.hidden_cases_authored: 84 by reviewer A across 20 units; at least one per unit by reviewer B
independent_review_evidence.standing_rule: the stricter verdict governs while independent reviewers disagree
independent_review_evidence.fabrication_note: both reviewers independently reported zero invented hashes, byte counts, metrics or outcomes, and recomputed evidence artifacts byte for byte

measured_evaluation_properties.detection_detail: the controller withheld four of its own findings from the reviewers; one reviewer independently reproduced all four and found three more, giving complete recall of the controller's audit plus strict improvement on it
measured_evaluation_properties.disagreement_direction: both disagreements ran the same way, with the stricter reviewer finding clause-level failures against the frozen deliverable
measured_evaluation_properties.value_of_overlap: single-reviewer acceptance would have silently accepted two units that a second independent reviewer rejected on evidence

boundaries.po01_reads: immutable commits only, every SHA recorded in workstreams/po03/evidence/controller-run-binding.json

outstanding_work_for_a_successor_or_cont: dispose the 32 units no reviewer examined, using the same blind cross-family protocol
re-emit the 10 manifests recorded RETEST under the corrected emitter, as attempt-2 capsules rather than by rewriting immutable results
resolve the two inter-reviewer disagreements through a named human authority rather than a mechanical rule
re-demonstrate zero path collision against the repaired mechanism before Wave B may open
replace the saturated G2 instrument with a harder suite authored by a non-producer before any further compounding claim
evaluation_route: Independent Assurance & Acceptance, per the separation of duties in operations/README.md
